title: Half-Value Guarantee for Linear Constraints
statement: Let $r$ be a natural number and let $V$ be a finite set of variables. Consider a nonempty finite multiset of linear constraints over $\mathbb F_2$, each involving between one and $r+1$ distinct variables, with every variable in $V$ occurring in at least one constraint. The maximum, over assignments of elements of $\mathbb F_2$ to the variables, of the fraction of satisfied constraints is at least $1/2$.
hypotheses_covered: Each constraint has arity from $1$ through $r+1$
Every variable occurs in a constraint
